summary: Passed: in a test Deathmatch the winner's bonus round now gives turbo x1 on both arms, where it gave x5. The winner bonus round had x5 arm turbo hard-coded, and I changed it to x1 to match the chassis. I started a bonus round on a local test server and checked the turbo count. It stayed x1 after the bonus timer changed and cleared at the final standings.
